title: A newborn answers to rocking through the inner-ear balance sense
summary: MedlinePlus says a newborn's inner-ear balance sense responds to rocking and to changes of position.
body: The MedlinePlus sensory list names inner-ear, vestibular, senses and says the infant responds to rocking and to changes of position. The page was reviewed on 1 January 2025. The line is a general description of that response. It does not prescribe a rocking routine, and it is not a balance examination.

sources.title: Infant - newborn development
sources.author: MedlinePlus
sources.note: Supports the vestibular line: the infant responds to rocking and changes of position.
